scope.method: Finite actual-result engineering review, reusing accepted source and combined functional closure; small metadata, original queue receipts and bounded inode/stat checks only.
scope.statistics: Independent statistical acceptance is referenced, not recomputed by this engineering review.

identity.checks: Actual admission top-level request/source/review/host/quiet/attempt pins match; actual runtime and postrun references remain tied to this frozen candidate.

execution.schedule_check: Frozen native schedule, attempted IDs and completed IDs are identical ordered 4656-element lists with 4656 unique IDs; primary samples number 2328.
execution.queue_receipts: All six original metadata members were checked for each prelude, timing and offline-audit queue. W1 prelude completes before W3 timing dispatch; the original audit is a later separate functional lease. Queue wall/CPU/fault data describe processes, not eight-stage CPU time.

host_restoration.identity_check: PID, exact image, creation FILETIME and SID agree across fresh plan, ready and completed records.
host_restoration.result: Passed actual whole-timing-queue pause coverage; same token and two held handles, each successful suspension followed by one owned successful resume; requested_stop, restored=true, error=null. No kill/restart/priority change.
host_restoration.scope_limit: Editor, zenserver, Code and unrelated applications were retained. This is controlled-work quiet, not physical host exclusivity or a frequency-lock claim.

power.result: Actual High Performance ready and requested-stop completed records pass the original power audit; original Balanced GUID restored, error=null.
power.coverage_boundary: Original PowerWindow causally encloses the native loop. It closes before later runtime/analysis/seal work in the timing queue; it is not claimed to cover the entire queue. Process pause covers the entire queue. Native endpoint receipts and original offline audit confirm a valid complete native power window.
power.ordering_basis: Closed RESTORED, power-completed and actual pause-coverage identities are pinned in the actual pre-audit dispatch record. Do not order Windows UTC against WSL UTC.

runtime_and_storage.pooling_checks: All 13968 proof names equal 4656 attempts times wire/canonical/queries. Original native files had one link and were writable; full semantic validation preceded pooling; exact bytes were preserved; first-anchor or exact-byte comparison was recorded.
runtime_and_storage.bounded_stat_check: 32845 manifest-listed regular files checked by stat only, sizes matching; current logical 162423916976, unique-inode bytes 250181128, allocated 277299200, unique inodes 18877. This scope excludes manifest.json itself and the original queue. Post-ledger metadata explains the difference and is covered by reserve; it is not a body rehash.
runtime_and_storage.readonly_anchors_and_endpoint_slots: Seven anchors readonly with expected link counts; first two and last two jobs times three body slots match current anchor inode/size/read-only state.
runtime_and_storage.retained_scope: Original audit final retained total includes copied frozen/protocol/manifests/queue; generated wire, logical retained and allocated physical storage are distinct accounting scopes. No budget violation was reported.

original_offline_audit.postrun_pin_semantics: SC-POST-RUN-PIN-v1 composite of the actual run-manifest SHA and timing queue-manifest SHA, not the run-manifest SHA alone.

result_index_boundary.diagnosis: Index-only Python 3.10 parsing rejected a Windows seven-fraction timestamp. Original Q32 and original audit were already complete/exit0/clean. The preserved failed index was replaced by a new metadata-only indexer that uses actual pre-audit pinned closed restore/power/coverage identities rather than cross-clock timestamp comparison; WSL-to-WSL whole-queue pause coverage remains checked.

conclusion.limits: Q32 is the accepted qualification window with original audit and separate independent statistics. It is not F64, not proof of the 1.05/0.20 targets, not a total-cost improvement claim, and not authorization to run another window.
